alt.es: Cuatro contrastes secundarios descriptivos, cada uno con dos intervalos nominales del 95 %: bootstrap por escuelas y diagnóstico escuela+estudiante. Progresión y ausencia en eras histórica y moderna; puntos, años e intervalos exactos en CSV.
alt.en: Four secondary descriptive contrasts, each with two nominal 95% intervals: school bootstrap and school-plus-student diagnostic. Progression and absence in historical and modern eras; exact points, years and intervals in CSV.

caption.es: Comparación secundaria descriptiva de cambios de cohortes repetidas (pp): histórica 2008–2015; moderna 2016–2024 para progresión y 2016–2023 para ausencia. Cada punto muestra IC nominal 95 % por bootstrap de escuelas y diagnóstico normal escuela+estudiante. El diagnóstico tiene precisión débil; el bootstrap omite dependencia de estudiantes entre escuelas. Estimando y muestra difieren del primario: restar puntos no atribuye causalidad. Selección previa y tendencias paralelas sin verificar.
caption.en: Secondary descriptive comparison of changes in repeated cohorts (percentage points): historical 2008–2015; modern 2016–2024 for progression and 2016–2023 for absence. Each point shows a nominal 95% school-bootstrap interval and a normal school-plus-student diagnostic. The diagnostic has weak precision; the bootstrap omits cross-school student dependence. Estimand and sample differ from the primary result: subtracting points does not attribute causality. Prior selection and parallel trends remain unverified.

alt.en: Four descriptive bound segments for the fixed baseline population before missing outcomes: progression and actual non-enrollment in historical and modern eras. Endpoints are neither point estimates nor confidence intervals; exact values in CSV.

caption.es: Cuatro cotas descriptivas sobre celdas basales fijas (Sin registro o grado bajo el esperado, histórica 2005–2015; Sin registro o grado bajo el esperado, moderna 2016–2024; No escolarización real, histórica 2005–2015; No escolarización real, moderna 2016–2023), en puntos porcentuales; los extremos son límites de identificación, no intervalos de confianza ni estimaciones puntuales. La población incluye estudiantes antes de excluir desenlaces faltantes y no coincide necesariamente con la muestra primaria. En progresión se acota el éxito o fracaso de grados desconocidos; en no escolarización real se acota la participación verdadera, distinta de no observar registro. Las definiciones histórica y moderna difieren; no unir sus extremos como una serie causal.
caption.en: Four descriptive bounds for fixed baseline cells (No record or grade below expected level, historical 2005–2015; No record or grade below expected level, modern 2016–2024; Actual non-enrollment, historical 2005–2015; Actual non-enrollment, modern 2016–2023), percentage points; endpoints are identification limits, not confidence intervals or point estimates. The population includes students before missing outcomes are excluded and need not match the primary sample. Progression bounds unknown-grade success or failure; actual non-enrollment bounds true participation, which differs from no observed record. Historical and modern definitions differ; do not join endpoints as a causal series.

caption.es: D1/D2 en era moderna, progresión 2016–2024 y ausencia 2016–2023: cuatro contrastes descriptivos por desenlace, en puntos porcentuales; el D2 completo usa IC nominal 98,75 % y los otros tres usan 95 %, todos por escuelas. D2 completo, D2 muestra común, D1 muestra común y D1 completo separan composición de definición. Descomposición progreso: −0,02 + +0,00 + −3,08 = −3,10 pp; ausencia: −0,02 + +0,00 + −0,79 = −0,81 pp. Las sumas usan cifras sin redondear; puede haber discrepancia de centésimas visibles. Histórica 2005–2015: D1 y D2 clasifican los mismos eventos, por lo que no hay contraste discriminante ni punto que graficar. La muestra común y la completa no son idénticas; las diferencias entre puntos carecen de intervalo conjunto y no se interpretan como efecto causal.
caption.en: Modern D1/D2, progression 2016–2024 and absence 2016–2023: four descriptive contrasts per outcome, percentage points; full D2 uses a nominal 98.75% interval and the other three use 95%, all clustered by school. Full D2, common-sample D2, common-sample D1 and full D1 separate composition from definition. Progression decomposition: −0.02 + +0.00 + −3.08 = −3.10 pp; absence: −0.02 + +0.00 + −0.79 = −0.81 pp. Sums use unrounded values; displayed hundredths may differ. Historical 2005–2015 D1 and D2 classify the same events, so there is no discriminating contrast or plotted point. Common and full samples differ; point differences have no joint interval and are not interpreted as causal effects.

Generación anterior y posterior designan cohortes basales G−5 y G−1, con G como año del evento. La ventana comienza en año basal+5−grado: en 1.º medio de la generación anterior abarca G−1 y G. alt.en: SIES access, historical. later lost provision, earlier cohort: 45.9 %; lost provision, later cohort: 48.6 %; comparison, earlier cohort: 60.4 %; comparison, later cohort: 65.4 %; SIES record in 2 years after expected school completion (2009–2015): −2.3 pp [−5.3; +0.3]. School cohorts 2009–2015; students with valid ID and complete observed window. SIES undergraduate enrollment in the two years after expected school completion, not first entry. Earlier and later cohorts refer to baseline generations G−5 and G−1, where G is the event year. The window starts in baseline year+5−grade: for grade 1 of the earlier cohort it spans G−1 and G. The four rates use the same weights as the comparison-of-changes point; their difference in changes reproduces it, apart from rounding. The uncertainty interval applies only to that comparison, not to each rate. Student counts by group in CSV cover only the later cohort; school counts cover both cohorts. Support varies by cohort, grade and outcome; see coverage-all.csv and outcome-coverage-all.csv. Linkage bound uninformative. Closure definitions differ: do not pool periods. Parallel trends and interference remain unverified; these descriptive contrasts do not identify a causal effect.

Puntos e intervalos nominales en puntos porcentuales: 97,5 % salvo el diagnóstico de efectos fijos de otro estimando (95 %). El método de dos vías conserva el punto primario y cambia su precisión; el diagnóstico de efectos fijos cambia pesos y estimando. caption.en: Comparison sensitivities, historical era, SIES enrollment in the two years after expected school completion; periods 2009–2015; 2010–2015. Points and nominal intervals in percentage points: 97.5% except the fixed-effects diagnostic with a different estimand (95%). Two-way precision retains the primary point; the fixed-effects diagnostic changes weights and estimand. Future comparators, adjustments and support change samples; subtracting rows does not attribute causality. Years, schools, interval level and precision flags are in the linked table.

alt.en: Four descriptive A/B calendar contrasts, historical era: nearer and farther earlier cohorts, with and without both windows ending before G. Points and intervals are in the table; adjacent matrix documents window ends by horizon and grade.

caption.es: Calendario A/B de matrícula SIES en dos años tras egreso escolar esperado, era histórica; periodos 2010–2015; 2011–2015. A conserva cohortes basales anteriores pero algunas ventanas de desenlace alcanzan G; B retiene solo grados donde las dos ventanas terminan estrictamente antes de G. La matriz adyacente muestra los finales de la generación anterior y posterior por grado para acceso de dos años, matrícula en al menos dos de tres años y titulación en seis años; celdas elegibles por calendario B: 5/6, 3/6 y 0/6, respectivamente. Que solo termine antes de G la ventana anterior no satisface B. El filtro cambia grados y pesos; los IC nominales son 97,5 % y no prueban tendencias paralelas ni ausencia de anticipación. La cobertura observada se distingue de la elegibilidad por calendario.
caption.en: A/B calendar for SIES enrollment in the two years after expected school completion, historical era; periods 2010–2015; 2011–2015. A retains earlier baseline cohorts although some outcome windows reach G; B retains only grades for which both outcome windows end strictly before G. The adjacent matrix gives earlier and later cohort window ends by grade for two-year access, enrollment in at least two of three years and graduation within six years; calendar-eligible B cells: 5/6, 3/6 and 0/6, respectively. Only the earlier window ending before G does not qualify for B. The filter changes grades and weights; nominal intervals are 97.5% and do not test parallel trends or absence of anticipation. Observed support is distinct from calendar eligibility.
